claude.result:
The fix is complete and tested! The issue was floating point precision errors when converting prices like 39.95 to cents. I've wrapped the conversions with `Math.round()` in all three places where prices are converted to cents:

- `parseEuros()` for standard prices
- `cellCents()` for spreadsheet imports  
- `decimalCommaToCents()` for European comma-decimal format

The commit is ready pending your approval. Your gym membership (€39.95) now adds without errors, and Netflix/Spotify still work fine too.
